description: Source code for the PrioritizedDispatcher class, managing job scheduling with priorities in the net namespace.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher
classes.description: Manages job scheduling with priority levels, including adding, canceling, changing priorities, and setting limits.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Limits
classes.description: Defines limits for the dispatcher, including total jobs and reserved slots per priority.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a job with a specified priority to the dispatcher.

methods.name: AddAtHead
methods.description: Adds a job at the front of the queue with a specified priority.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a job using its handle.

methods.name: EvictOldestLowest
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest job with the lowest priority.

methods.name: ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of a job.

methods.name: OnJobFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of a job and potentially dispatches the next job.

methods.name: MaybeDispatchJob
methods.description: Attempts to dispatch a specific job if limits allow.

methods.name: MaybeDispatchNextJob
methods.description: Attempts to dispatch the next queued job.
